page.layout: One page, title page. Centred title block: large heading "PHYSIOGNO-" with "MONIA IE-" and "SVITICA" below; then an indented group of four lines, "expressa" set apart; then "Studio & opera"; then the author's name; then the imprint "LVGDVNI" with "Anno Christi" and the date below. A printer's ornament stands between the handwritten lines and the imprint. Stamps and handwriting are not transcribed.
page.notes: Printed text is copied as set. Long s is given as plain s. The title's "IESVITICA" and imprint "LVGDVNI" are rendered with u as the vowel, per the rules. The date is printed in the old reversed-C form (CIↃ IↃC X), which reads MDCX; the final mark after X is a printed stop or flaw. Not transcribed: the circular library stamp at left ("Bibliothèque de la Ville de Lyon", 1895), the Lyon city seal at lower right, the number 324329 at top right, and the handwritten lines in the centre ("Bibliotheca M. St. Bernardi Fontanensis ... Fulinensis"), which are manuscript ownership notes. The printer's ornament between them is decorative and not text.
